en.Cage 已在运行，但窗口暂时无法唤起。请从任务栏打开 Cage。: Cage is already running, but its window can't be brought up. Open Cage from the taskbar.
en.Cage 需要 Windows 10 22H2（19045）或 Windows: Cage needs Windows 10 22H2 (19045) or Windows 11 on x64 (Intel/AMD).
en.保存后停止环境并完成更新: Stop the environment after saving and finish the update
en.保存并停止环境后安装重启: Save, stop the environment, then install and restart
en.保存文件后完成更新: Finish the update after saving files
en.启动工作台失败：等待本机后台响应超时。请点击“重试连接”；仍失败时请保留此提示并: The workbench failed to start: timed out waiting for the local backend. Click "Retry connection"; if it still fails, keep this message and report it to the maintainers.
en.工作台显示进程已退出。后台任务保留，可重试连接。: The workbench display process exited. Background tasks are kept; you can retry the connection.
en.打开现有环境保存文件: Open the current environment to save files
en.正在停止环境并切换到新版后台…: Stopping the environment and switching to the new backend…
en.缺少 Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime。请运行 C: Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is missing. Run the Cage installer to install the bundled runtime, then try again.
en.请先保存文件。继续后将停止 Cage 环境并完成后台更新，终端任务会结束，项目和: Save your files first. Continuing stops the Cage environment and finishes the backend update; terminal tasks end, while projects and sign-ins are kept.
en.请先保存编辑器中的文件并结束正在运行的工作。继续后 Cage 会停止环境、安装已: Save files in the editor and finish running work first. Continuing stops the environment, installs the verified update and restarts Cage.
en.请选择普通文件，暂不支持文件夹或链接: Choose regular files; folders and links aren't supported yet
en.这会停止现有环境和终端任务，再切换到新版后台。项目文件和登录状态会保留。请先保存: This stops the current environment and terminal tasks, then switches to the new backend. Project files and sign-ins are kept. Save changes in the editor first.
en.Linux 版本通过安装包更新。请保存文件、停止环境并退出 Cage，再安装已核: The Linux version updates through its package. Save your files, stop the environment and quit Cage, then install the official new version after checking its digest.
en.打开工作台失败：等待本机后台响应超时。请点击“重试连接”；仍失败时请保留此错误提: Couldn't open the workbench: timed out waiting for the local backend. Click "Retry connection"; if it still fails, keep this error and report it to the maintainers. Background tasks don't end because of this.
en.打开工作台失败：本机后台没有接受连接，可能尚未启动或已经退出。请点击“重试连接”: Couldn't open the workbench: the local backend didn't accept the connection; it may not have started or may have exited. Click "Retry connection"; if it still fails, keep this error and report it to the maintainers. Background tasks don't end because of this.
en.打开工作台失败：本机工作台连接在加载完成前中断。请点击“重试连接”；仍失败时请保: Couldn't open the workbench: the local workbench connection dropped before loading finished. Click "Retry connection"; if it still fails, keep this error and report it to the maintainers. Background tasks don't end because of this.
en.打开工作台失败：内置网页组件未能加载本机工作台（错误代码 {0}）。请点击“重试: Couldn't open the workbench: the built-in web component couldn't load the local workbench (error code {0}). Click "Retry connection"; if it still fails, keep this error and report it to the maintainers. Background tasks don't end because of this.
en.启动工作台失败：本机后台未返回可识别的原因（错误代码 {0}）。请点击“重试连接: The workbench failed to start: the local backend returned no recognizable reason (error code {0}). Click "Retry connection"; if it still fails, keep this message and report it to the maintainers.
Built on agent-vm, Lima, Chromium, noVNC and xterm.js
en.当前连接旧后台；更新尚未完成。: Connected to the old backend; the update isn't finished.
en.云端 Cage 可以读取、修改和删除所选项目中的文件。: The cloud Cage can read, modify and delete files in the selected project.
en.云端 Cage 可以读取所选项目中的文件。: The cloud Cage can read files in the selected project.
en.仅此文件夹会与 Cage 共享。请选择具体项目。: Only this folder is shared with Cage. Choose a specific project.
en.后台返回了无效的工作台入口。: The backend returned an invalid workbench entry.
en.请选择用于保存镜像和虚拟磁盘的空文件夹。: Choose an empty folder for images and virtual disks.
